description: rules check writes a label of the configuration, which may hold any text, as an error escapes it (G16): a rule labelled Trailer, U+202E RIGHT-TO-LEFT OVERRIDE, then vkm, which an earlier rule hides whole, is written with \u{202E} in the warning of its human text, never as it is, which would make the line read in another order; --json gives the label as it is.
config:
pool_id = "p"
catalog = "${SANDBOX}/catalog.db"
[view]
mount = "${SANDBOX}/pool"
[[rule]]
label = "films"
path = "Films/**"
[[rule]]
label = "Trailer\u202Evkm"
path = "Films/**"
ext = ["mkv"]
